summary: Tested the NEW Edit Profile screen (display name + avatar upload via Emergent Object Storage) added this session. Backend: 11 new tests written for POST/GET /me/avatar + display-name regression, all pass. Full regression suite (41 pre-existing tests) also re-run and passing (52/52 total). Frontend: live Playwright flow on mobile viewport (390x844) — navigated More hub -> Edit Profile, edited display name (Save correctly disabled until dirty, success toast, propagated to More hub row AND Today greeting), uploaded a real avatar image via file chooser (upload spinner badge, success toast), and verified the SAME uploaded avatar renders in all 3 places: Edit Profile screen, More hub profile row, and Today header top-right circle — confirming GET /api/me/avatar with ?token= query-param auth works correctly on web. All requested flows pass, no bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/deps.py get_current_user_id_flexible correctly prioritizes Bearer header over query token and validates typ=='access' the same as the strict dependency — no auth bypass risk found.
models/user.py Profile.avatar_object_path correctly uses Field(exclude=True) — verified via test that it never leaks in POST /me/avatar or GET /me responses.

routes/users.py upload_avatar validates content-type allowlist (jpeg/png/webp) BEFORE reading bytes into memory but reads the full body before the size check — for a 5MB cap this is a negligible risk, not flagging as an issue, just noting for awareness if the cap is ever raised.
core/storage.py has clean 503-retry-once logic for expired storage_key on both put_object/get_object — good resilience pattern.
AvatarImage.tsx correctly branches web (query token, since can't set Authorization headers) vs native (Bearer header) — matches the integration playbook's stated fallback contract exactly.

success_rate.backend: 52/52 (100%) — 11 new avatar/profile tests + 41 pre-existing regression tests
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows tested and passing

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created their own isolated pytest+avatar+<uuid>@lifeos.app users (module-scoped, no cleanup needed as they're throwaway). PATCH /me/profile display_name + ai_enabled regression both pass. (2) Frontend — full Playwright flow: login -> More hub -> tap profile row -> Edit Profile screen renders (initials avatar, display name field, disabled email field, disabled Save) -> edited name shows Save enabled -> Save -> toast 'Name updated' -> More hub header + Today greeting both reflect new name -> tapped avatar circle -> native file chooser (expected web behavior per playbook) -> uploaded test JPEG -> upload badge spinner -> toast 'Avatar updated' -> new image renders on Edit Profile, More hub row, AND Today header avatar (all 3 surfaces confirmed via screenshot). Backend logs confirmed 200 OK on all POST/GET /me/avatar calls including the ?token= query-param GET calls used by AvatarImage.tsx on web. No bugs found this session — testuser@lifeos.app account is left with display_name 'Testuser Updated' and a red-square test avatar set (cosmetic state change only).
